F2_G5.change: one-sided paired sign-flip test (Monte Carlo) on per-pair ln ratios with b = max(20000, ceil(20/alpha_i)); alpha_i = lord.next_alpha(prior) depends only on earlier rejections, so b is fixed before the data; p floor 1/(b+1) <= alpha_i/20 at every level; valid for any b; no normality assumption (AB/BA randomisation justifies the null). LORD++ unchanged: FDR 0.05, W0 0.025, C 0.0722. Bootstrap p removed; bootstrap CI kept for reporting.
F2_G5.w0_rationale: W0 = alpha/2 = 0.025. ~30 tests/night without rejection: alpha 1.25e-3 (t=1), 2.3e-4 (t=3), 9.1e-5 (t=10), 3.2e-5 (t=30), spending 0.0037 of 0.025 wealth; larger W0 raises those at most 2x but shrinks the first rejection's reward; after a rejection levels are nearly W0-independent (alpha_30 ~6.5e-5). 80% power at n=37, sigma 0.0376 needs ~2.4% (t=1) to ~3.0% (t=30). Recorded in lord.W0_RATIONALE, prereg fdr.w0_rationale and FIX-PREREG.json.
